questions.q: The goalkeeper is hidden. Where should the keeper stand while the fixo pressures?
questions.explain: Yes. The fixo pressures the ball, so the keeper sets near goal and keeps a view of the shot.

questions.q: The receiver is free on the right. Which picture shows the best keeper position?
options: Keeper in the middle of goal
Keeper right up at the attacker
questions.explain: Right. A few controlled steps toward the ball close the angle, and you can still react.
choiceExplanations: Holding the middle leaves a big gap at the near post for the attacker to shoot into.
Right. A few controlled steps toward the ball close the angle, and you can still react.

questions.q: Now the free runner is on the left. Drag the KEEPER to close the angle.
options: Take a few steps toward the ball
questions.explain: Yes. A few steps toward the ball side close the near post, and you stay balanced.
choiceExplanations: That is too far and out of control. The attacker can dribble round you or chip you.
